title: The section component locus admits local smooth noetherian models
statement: Let g:P→T be smooth, quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], with a section σ satisfying σ≫g=id. For every x∈P there is an open W containing x, schemes P₀,T₀ with T₀ noetherian, a smooth quasi-compact quasi-separated g₀:P₀→T₀ with a section σ₀, and a scheme morphism a:W→P₀ such that, for every w∈W, w belongs to the component of σ(g(w)) in its g-fibre if and only if a(w) belongs to the component of σ₀(g₀(a(w))) in its g₀-fibre.

source.place: Tag 055Q, first two paragraphs (noetherian approximation), and Tag 055M (base change)

proof.text: Obtain W,V, the noetherian smooth model, both cartesian squares and the compatible restricted section from the model-data theorem.

For w in W, apply the component base-change theorem first to the restriction square and then to the model square. Reverse the first equivalence and compose it with the second. Package the existing model data and this equivalence into the conclusion.
